variants.name: UnityChan_V1_ShortHairDuelist
variants.description: She wears her hair short: twin tails, tail tips, clips and head ribbons are off. Crimson jacket, black shirt, gold trim, fair skin, blue eyes, angry face, sword in her right hand.

variants.name: UnityChan_V2_JacketlessScholar
variants.description: Jacket, vest back and buttons are off, so the shirt and skirt read on their own. Navy and gold, honey hair, a mage hat, and a calm smile. Slightly shorter.

variants.name: UnityChan_V3_RibbonKnight
variants.description: Ribbons and twin tails are larger. White-and-gold uniform, warm eyes, sword and shield. Taller than the base.

variants.name: UnityChan_V4_SleevelessNight
variants.description: Sleeves and the head ribbon are off. Violet-and-black clothes, near-black hair, red eyes, a half mask and a dagger.

variants.name: UnityChan_V5_PetiteArcher
variants.description: Petite archer. Teal hair worn longer, forest clothes, green eyes, bow and quiver.

variants.name: PicoChan_V1_StreetMechanic
variants.description: Street clothes: jacket, goggles, bag robot and the four hair tails are off. Orange shirt, pink bob, angry expression, sword.

variants.name: PicoChan_V2_HoodedPilot
variants.description: Hooded jacket stays. Goggles and the bag robot are off. Ice-blue clothes, blue hair, mage hat. A little shorter.

variants.name: PicoChan_V3_BagCompanion
variants.description: Jacket off so the shirt shows. Goggles and a larger bag robot stay. Rose clothes, rose hair, cheerful face, dagger.

variants.name: PicoChan_V4_ShortHairKnight
variants.description: Hair tails off, jacket on in white and gold. Sword and shield. Tallest Pico variant.

variants.name: PicoChan_V5_MageTinkerer
variants.description: Jacket, goggles and bag are off. Long purple hair, violet shirt, mage hat. Shortest Pico variant.

variants.name: Casual1_V1_Hair1SmileFencer
variants.description: Hair 1, shipped eye colour 2, smile, warm casual outfit, fair skin, sword. One of the five shipped hairstyles.

variants.name: Casual1_V2_Hair2FangedRogue
variants.description: Hair 2, shipped eye colour 3, angry face with fangs, black-red outfit, darker hair, dagger.

variants.name: Casual1_V3_Hair3TiredMage
variants.description: Hair 3, shipped eye colour 4, sad expression, mint outfit, mage hat.

variants.name: Casual1_V4_Hair4TallArcher
variants.description: Hair 4, shipped eye colour 2 with a cooler grade, surprised expression, sky outfit, bow and quiver. Tallest Casual variant.

variants.name: Casual1_V5_Hair5MaskedGuard
variants.description: Hair 5, shipped eye colour 3, cheerful eyes, plum outfit, half mask and shield.

variants.name: Casual1_V6_Hair4MakeupChampion
variants.description: Hair 4 again, but with the shipped makeup face, eye colour 4, fangs, sand-and-gold outfit and a greatsword. Reads apart from the tall archer.

variants.name: Akio_V1_CrimsonFencer
variants.description: One-piece school body, so parts cannot be toggled. Crimson bottoms, auburn hair scaled up, blue eyes, angry face, sword. Slightly shorter.

variants.name: Akio_V2_NightScholar
variants.description: Violet uniform, silver-lilac hair worn smaller, red eyes, sorrowful face, mage hat and dagger.

variants.name: Akio_V3_GroveArcher
variants.description: Olive uniform, warm brown hair, green eyes, cheerful face, bow and quiver. Taller.

variants.name: Akio_V4_GoldCaptain
variants.description: White-and-gold uniform, blonde hair, amber eyes, bright smile, sword and shield. Tallest Akio variant.

variants.name: Aika_V1_RoseIdol
variants.description: Rose uniform and rose hair, blue eyes, smile, dagger. Shortest Aika variant. Separate from Akio's crimson fencer by hue and weapon.

variants.name: Aika_V2_FrostMage
variants.description: Ice-blue uniform, pale silver hair, blue eyes, surprised face, mage hat.

variants.name: Aika_V3_OliveArcher
variants.description: Moss uniform, dark-blonde hair, green eyes, cheerful face, bow and quiver.

variants.name: Aika_V4_WineGuard
variants.description: Wine uniform, black-red hair, red eyes, angry face, sword and shield. Tall.

variants.name: Akane_V1_PastelWitch
variants.description: Petite pastel witch. Lavender clothes, pink hair, violet eyes, cheerful face, mage hat.

variants.name: Akane_V2_InkDuelist
variants.description: Black-and-red clothes, black hair, red eyes, angry face, sword.

variants.name: Akane_V3_SunnyArcher
variants.description: Marigold clothes, honey hair, amber eyes, smile, bow and quiver. Tallest Akane variant.

variants.name: Akane_V4_MossSquire
variants.description: Moss clothes, brown hair, green eyes, sad face, shield.

variants.name: Cultist_V1_WhiteCantor
variants.description: The robe is one mesh, so the silhouette stays. This one is a pale gold-white robe, honey hair, blue eyes, smile, half mask.

variants.name: Cultist_V2_CrimsonRite
variants.description: Crimson robe, black-red hair, red eyes, angry face, dagger. Slightly shorter.

variants.name: Cultist_V3_VerdantOracle
variants.description: Green robe, teal hair, green eyes, cheerful face, mage hat. Taller.

variants.name: Cultist_V4_NightBow
variants.description: Deep blue robe, silver-blue hair, blue eyes, sad face, bow and quiver.

variants.name: StellarWitch_V1_UnrobedDuelist
variants.description: Hat, robe and scarf are off, leaving blouse and drawers. Red hair, angry face has no blend shapes on this rig, sword.

variants.name: StellarWitch_V2_NightOracle
variants.description: Full robe and hat, violet cloth, lilac hair, half mask. Hair bones slightly larger.

variants.name: StellarWitch_V3_ScarflessArcher
variants.description: Scarf off, hat kept, teal robe, teal hair, bow and quiver.

variants.name: StellarWitch_V4_TaillessKnight
variants.description: Back tail and earring off. Gold-white robe, blonde hair, sword and shield. Tallest witch variant.

variants.name: SanpakuChan_V1_PinkBlade
variants.description: Pink clothes and hair, blue eyes, sword. Hair bones enlarged. The tail is not a separate renderer, so it cannot be toggled.

variants.name: SanpakuChan_V2_BlueMage
variants.description: Blue clothes, pale blue hair, mage hat.

variants.name: SanpakuChan_V3_InkMask
variants.description: Black-red clothes, dark hair, red eyes, half mask and dagger. Slightly taller.

variants.name: SanpakuChan_V4_SeaArcher
variants.description: Sea-green clothes and hair, bow and quiver. Shortest Sanpaku variant.

variants.name: Reika_V1_HatlessSnow
variants.description: Holiday hat off. Pale ice dress, silver-blue hair, blue eyes, open mouth, sword. Shorter. This rig has no smile shape.

variants.name: Reika_V2_CrimsonCarol
variants.description: Hat stays. Crimson dress, dark red hair, red eyes, raised brows, dagger.

variants.name: Reika_V3_HollyArcher
variants.description: Hat off. Holly-green dress, brown-green hair, green eyes, a wider open mouth, bow and quiver. Tallest Reika variant.

variants.name: Reika_V4_MidnightBell
variants.description: Hat stays. Midnight violet dress, violet hair, violet eyes, sad face, half mask.

variants.name: Fina_V1_CoralSprinter
variants.description: Back hair off for a shorter silhouette. Coral top, warm hair, blue eyes, smile, sword.

variants.name: Fina_V2_BobDuelist
variants.description: Back and mid hair off, leaving the front hair. Blue clothes, cool hair, angry face, dagger. Shorter.

variants.name: Fina_V3_FullHairArcher
variants.description: All three hair pieces stay. Green street clothes, green-brown hair, bow and quiver. Taller.

variants.name: Fina_V4_SleevelessKnight
variants.description: The top mesh named topic is off. Gold accents, sword-length greatsword and shield, angry face.

variants.name: SapphiArtchan_V1_ClassRibbon
variants.description: Chequer collar and back-skirt tiles off. Rose uniform, warm hair, blue eyes, smile, sword. Rig is Generic, so humanoid retargets will not play.

variants.name: SapphiArtchan_V2_MechKnight
variants.description: Skirts off so the mech legs and boots carry the silhouette. Blue-and-gold, sword and shield. Tallest.

variants.name: SapphiArtchan_V3_SkirtMage
variants.description: Mech covers and outer mech shells off, skirts stay. Orchid clothes, pink hair, mage hat. Shorter.

variants.name: SapphiArtchan_V4_LiteArcher
variants.description: Tile pieces off. Sea-green clothes, bow and quiver. Shortest Sapphi variant.

variants.name: Muryotaisu_V1_HaloKnight
variants.description: Coat and halo stay. The halo bone is scaled up. Gold-white coat, blonde hair, amber eyes, smile, sword.

variants.name: Muryotaisu_V2_CoatlessDuelist
variants.description: Coat off. The body renderer remains. Black-red hair, red eyes, troubled face, dagger. Shorter. This rig has no angry shape.

variants.name: Muryotaisu_V3_RinglessMage
variants.description: Halo off. Violet coat and hair, mage hat, mouth open. Tallest Muryotaisu variant.

variants.name: Muryotaisu_V4_GroveArcher
variants.description: Green coat, green-brown hair, green eyes, eyes closed, bow and quiver. Halo stays at normal size. This rig has no sad shape.
